components.meaning: Source-native remuneration records linking a payment event to its distinct service event. This repairs prior event-root, payer/payee, worker/employer, amount, and service-period role failures without deciding whether remuneration is wages or whether an employer threshold is met.
components.prompt: As part of one joint full-case read, extract every expressly stated remuneration-for-service record relevant to the actual kernel. The native query may identify queried roles or parameters but is not evidence of a payment or service. Preserve payer, payee, numeric amount, worker, employer, stated service kind, inclusive service endpoints, and a payment date only if expressly stated. A service period is not a payment date. Every positive record must have at least one nonempty verbatim facts witness. Complete means the finite current case was inspected; [] is completed source absence, while null with unread means extraction was not completed. Preserve coherent alternatives and do not total, allocate, classify wages, apply thresholds, or decide the target claim.

components.meaning: Annual income events and explicitly directed section-151(b)/(c) givens with retained polarity. It prevents malformed arities, uncontrolled repetition, and simultaneous positive/negative fabrication.
components.prompt: As part of one joint full-case read, extract stated annual incomes and explicit section 151(b) or 151(c) givens. For an allowance given, preserve subsection, taxpayer, other person, taxpayer year, and positive or negative polarity in the original direction. Do not derive an allowance from marriage, kinship, income, or the target question. Deduplicate identical records. Every positive or negative record requires a nonempty verbatim facts witness. Complete [] means the finite source contains no matching statement; unread must use null. Do not calculate any deduction or target answer.

components.meaning: Shared marriage, return, and itemized-deduction observations. A stated marriage commencement is lowered as a valid start-only native event; no invented end or converter-level persistence requirement is added.
components.prompt: As part of one joint full-case read, extract directed marriage events, actual joint or separate return statements, and actual itemized-deduction statements. Represent expressly continuing wording as ongoing_since, a bare stated commencement as onset_only, and a marriage with two stated endpoints as closed_interval. Preserve both spouses. Do not invent an endpoint, turn a separate return into a joint return, or infer itemization from a return type. Every positive record requires a nonempty verbatim facts witness. Complete [] is finite source absence; null/unread is unresolved extraction. The question may identify roles or years but cannot establish any event or status.

components.meaning: Actual death events with deceased person and actual death date. Facts-only record witnesses prevent the previously observed fabrication of a taxpayer death from a target question.
components.prompt: As part of one joint full-case read, extract only deaths expressly stated in the current facts. Preserve the deceased person and actual death date. A target question saying that a legal section applies to a person in a year is never a death statement and cannot witness a death record. Every death requires at least one nonempty verbatim facts witness. Complete [] means the complete finite facts contain no death statement; null/unread means extraction was not completed. Do not infer a death, marriage endpoint, statutory window, or legal status.

components.meaning: Source-only service, educational-institution, enrollment, and regular-attendance observations retaining institution identity and supported temporal form.
components.prompt: As part of one joint full-case read, extract witnessed services with worker and employer, educational-institution classifications, enrollments, and regular-class attendance. Enrollment and attendance must retain their own institution identifiers. Use ongoing_since only for continuing wording, closed_interval only for two supported endpoints, active_on_date for an expressly dated status, and onset_only for a bare commencement. Do not infer enrollment from attendance, attendance from enrollment, or institution identity from similarity. Positive records require facts witnesses. Complete [] is finite absence and null/unread is extraction uncertainty. Do not decide the student-service exception.

components.meaning: New source-only linked employment, disabling/death condition, retirement, termination, and payment records needed by the termination-payment exclusion. It supplies factual events only and does not infer a plan or statutory exclusion.
components.prompt: As part of one joint full-case read, extract each coherent expressly linked termination-benefit episode. Preserve payer, payee, amount, optional actual payment date, worker, employer, employment endpoints, termination date, the stated condition kind and date, and whether retirement is expressly stated. Set explicitly_linked_to_termination true only when the facts expressly connect the payment to termination and the condition to that termination; otherwise preserve a separate coherent view or mark unread. Do not infer a plan, a missing date, an employment termination, or clause applicability. The native query may name the queried payment event but cannot establish it. Every record requires a nonempty verbatim facts witness. Complete [] is finite absence; null/unread is unresolved extraction.

components.meaning: New source-only directed family relationships and shared-residence intervals for dependency clauses. Direction is explicit: related_person bears relation_type to reference_person.
components.prompt: As part of one joint full-case read, extract expressly stated directed family relationships and shared-residence episodes. For each relationship, related_person is the person who is the stated son, daughter, father, mother, brother, sister, or sibling of reference_person. For residence, preserve every stated resident, any expressly named location, and exact supported endpoints. Do not reverse kinship, infer age, infer a joint return from marriage, extend a residence interval, or decide dependency. Every positive record requires a nonempty verbatim facts witness. Complete [] is completed source absence; null/unread is unresolved extraction.

value.rationale: The cumulative library preserves the useful prior distinctions, adds only the source-native primitives needed by the three new TRAIN cases, and shares marriage, return, payment, service, and temporal observations across clauses. Error provenance is limited to changes actually motivated by recorded failures: malformed/repeated section-151 facts, event-role inversion, invented marriage endpoints, the removed marriage-onset gate, and deaths invented from a target question. Employment-termination benefits and family/residence relations are new source-only primitives, so their error-feedback lists are empty. The binding accepts an expressly stated marriage onset as a start-only native event, never creates a death from a question, preserves unread separately from completed absence, and leaves all legal conclusions to the unchanged author programs. The reviewed common correction brings both historical arms to 4/4, so this update does not claim an established method advantage.
